problem:
Let $L$ be the set of all functions $f:R\to R$ of the form $f(x)=ax+1,$ where $a\in R.$ Complete the following sentence:

*$L$ is **not** a vector space (with respect to function addition and scalar multiplication of a function by a real number) because $\text{_________}\,.$*

choices.value: multiplication of $f\in L$ by a scalar is not closed
addition and scalar multiplication of functions in $L$ do not satisfy the distributive laws
addition of functions in $L$ is not commutative
addition of functions in $L$ is not associative

feedback.problem:
From top to bottom, fill in the blanks and hence complete the proof of the following statement using the axioms $[\text{A}1]-[\text{A}8]$ given below.

*Statement:*

*Given any $x\in V$, if $w$ is a vector such that $x+w=0$, then $w=-x$* 

*Proof:*

$$
\begin{aligned}x+w & =0 &  & [\,\text{given}\,] \\ (x+w)+(-x) & =0+(-x) &  & [\,\text{add }-x\text{ to both sides}\,] \\ (w+x)+(-x) & =(-x)+0 &  & [\,\text{axiom __}\,] \\ (w+x)+(-x) & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,] \\ w+(x+(-x)) & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom A2}\,\,] \\ w+0 & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom __}\,] \\ w & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,\,]\end{aligned}
$$

The axioms:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{[A1]}:x+y=y+x & \text{[A5]}:1\cdot x=x \\ \text{[A2]}:(x+y)+z=x+(y+z) & \text{[A6]}:\alpha (\beta x)=(\alpha \beta )x \\ \text{[A3]}:x+0=x & \text{[A7]}:(\alpha +\beta )x=\alpha x+\beta x \\ \text{[A4]}:x+(-x)=0 & \text{[A8]}:\alpha (x+y)=\alpha x+\alpha y\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the vector space axioms, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}x+w & =0 &  & [\,\text{given}\,] \\ (x+w)+(-x) & =0+(-x) &  & [\,\text{add }-x\text{ to both sides}\,] \\ (w+x)+(-x) & =(-x)+0 &  & [\,\text{axiom }A1\,] \\ (w+x)+(-x) & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom A3}\,] \\ w+(x+(-x)) & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom }\text{A2}\,\,] \\ w+0 & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom }A4\,] \\ w & =-x &  & [\,\text{axiom }\text{A3}\,\,]\end{aligned}
$$
